calls.title: Usage totals wrong on annual plans

arguments.title: Annual-plan usage totals are twelve times too high
arguments.body:
## Problem
Usage totals for customers on the annual plan show twelve times the real amount.

## Suggested approach
Drafted by the agent from the discussion; adjust before starting.

1. Find where annual usage is summed.
2. Divide by the plan's months, not the year.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Annual-plan usage totals match the monthly totals
